Package paint.viewer.ui.panels

Class RecordingControlsPanel

java.lang.Object
paint.viewer.ui.panels.RecordingControlsPanel
public class RecordingControlsPanel extends Object
A user interface panel containing interactive controls for managing recordings and grid visualization settings within the PAINT viewer.

  • Constructor Details

    • RecordingControlsPanel

      public RecordingControlsPanel(RecordingControlsPanel.RecordingsControlListener recordingsControlListener)
      Constructs a RecordingControlsPanel containing action buttons, visualization toggles, and numbering mode options. All actions are delegated to the provided RecordingControlsPanel.RecordingsControlListener.
      Parameters:
      recordingsControlListener - the recordingsControlListener that receives callbacks when user actions occur

    • setButtonsEnabled

      public void setButtonsEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables all action buttons on the panel.

      This is used to disable user interaction while modal dialogs are open or while long-running operations are in progress.

      Parameters:
      enabled - true to enable all action buttons, false to disable them

    • setExcludeButtonText

      public void setExcludeButtonText(boolean excluded)
      Updates the text and appearance of the exclusion toggle button based on the current recording's exclusion status.
      Parameters:
      excluded - true if the recording is currently excluded, false otherwise
